Start with training and inference","zh":"一、先理解两件事：训练与推理"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"An AI chip accelerates numerical operations such as matrix multiplication, but its usefulness depends on memory, communication, and software as well as arithmetic. Training repeatedly performs forward computation, backpropagation, and parameter updates. Inference uses trained weights to produce predictions or generate tokens. The two workloads share many operations while putting different pressures on the system.","zh":"AI芯片的工作是加速矩阵乘法等数值运算，但它是否好用，同时取决于内存、通信和软件。训练需要反复执行前向计算、反向传播和参数更新；推理则使用已经训练好的权重产生预测或生成token。两者共享大量算子，对系统的压力却不完全相同。"},{"en":"AWS developed Inferentia primarily for inference and Trainium with training as a central design goal. The names are useful orientation, but not strict capability boundaries: AWS explicitly positions Trainium2 and Trainium3 for both training and inference. NVIDIA's data-center GPUs also serve both workloads. It would therefore be misleading to reduce the choice to Inferentia for serving and Trainium or GPUs only for training.","zh":"AWS的Inferentia主要面向推理，Trainium则以训练为重要设计目标。但名称不能当作严格的功能边界：AWS明确将Trainium2和Trainium3用于训练与推理。英伟达的数据中心GPU同样覆盖两类任务。因此，不能简单地把选择归纳成“推理只能选Inferentia，Trainium和GPU只能训练”。"},{"en":"This article focuses on capabilities documented by September 30, 2026. Product specifications below are attributed to the vendors; the workload-selection guidance is engineering analysis, rather than a claim based on an independent head-to-head benchmark.","zh":"本文围绕截至2026年9月30日已有官方资料的能力展开。下文硬件规格来自厂商资料，选型建议属于工程分析，并非基于本文自行开展的芯片对跑测试。"}],"sources":[1,3,4,7]},{"heading":{"en":"2. Inferentia: inference-oriented acceleration","zh":"二、Inferentia：围绕推理效率设计"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Inferentia is AWS's inference-oriented accelerator family, exposed through EC2 Inf instances. Inferentia1 powers Inf1; Inferentia2 powers Inf2. AWS's 2023 architecture description gives each Inferentia2 chip two NeuronCore-v2 cores and 32 GB of HBM with 820 GB/s memory bandwidth. The largest Inf2 size combines twelve chips and 384 GB of accelerator memory.","zh":"Inferentia是AWS面向推理的加速器家族，通过EC2 Inf系列实例提供。Inferentia1对应Inf1，Inferentia2对应Inf2。AWS在2023年的架构介绍中给出的Inferentia2规格是：每芯片两个NeuronCore-v2、32GB HBM，以及820GB/s内存带宽。最大的Inf2规格组合12颗芯片，提供384GB加速器内存。"},{"en":"Its functional building blocks include tensor, vector, scalar, and programmable GPSIMD engines. These support the mixture of matrix operations, normalization, and other computation in neural networks. NeuronLink lets a model be partitioned across chips. Supported numerical formats include BF16 and FP16 as well as configurable FP8; hardware format support does not mean every model or software path uses that format optimally.","zh":"它的功能模块包括张量、向量、标量和可编程GPSIMD引擎，用来处理神经网络中的矩阵运算、归一化及其他计算。NeuronLink支持把模型分片到多颗芯片上。数值格式包括BF16、FP16和可配置FP8等；硬件支持某种格式，并不意味着所有模型和软件路径都已经针对它完成优化。"},{"en":"A common use case is a supported model that runs continuously at production scale: text generation, embeddings, or classification. In autoregressive generation, prefill processes the prompt and decode repeatedly emits new tokens. The balance between compute and memory traffic changes with prompt length, batch size, and concurrency, so a single throughput figure is not enough to predict user experience.","zh":"典型候选任务是长期运行、部署规模较大且软件已经支持的模型，例如文本生成、向量表示或分类。自回归生成还可分为处理提示词的prefill与逐token生成的decode；提示长度、批大小和并发会改变计算与内存访问之间的关系，因此单个吞吐数字不足以预测实际体验。"}],"sources":[1,2]},{"heading":{"en":"3. Trainium: from training chips to large AI systems","zh":"三、Trainium：从训练芯片扩展到大型AI系统"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"The Trainium family is designed for demanding deep-learning workloads, including pretraining and fine-tuning. Its newer generations also target inference. AWS's December 2024 Trainium2 launch describes eight NeuronCores per chip, 96 GiB of HBM, and 2.9 TB/s of memory bandwidth. A Trn2 instance contains sixteen chips; a Trn2 UltraServer links sixty-four through NeuronLink.","zh":"Trainium家族面向预训练、微调等高负载深度学习任务，新一代产品也覆盖推理。AWS于2024年12月发布的Trainium2资料介绍了每芯片八个NeuronCore、96GiB HBM和2.9TB/s内存带宽。一个Trn2实例包含16颗芯片，Trn2 UltraServer通过NeuronLink连接64颗芯片。"},{"en":"Trainium3 was announced as generally available on December 2, 2025. AWS lists a 3 nm process, 144 GB HBM3e, 4.9 TB/s memory bandwidth, and 2.52 PFLOPS of FP8 compute per chip. Trn3 UltraServers scale to 144 chips with NeuronSwitch-v1 connectivity. These are vendor specifications, and the maximum system configuration is distinct from an individual chip.","zh":"Trainium3于2025年12月2日宣布正式可用。AWS列出的单芯片规格包括3nm工艺、144GB HBM3e、4.9TB/s内存带宽和2.52PFLOPS FP8算力；Trn3 UltraServer可扩展至144颗芯片，并使用NeuronSwitch-v1互联。这些属于厂商规格，应区分单芯片指标与最大系统配置。"},{"en":"For training, communication is central: gradients, optimizer state, activations, and sharded parameters must move between devices according to the parallelization strategy. NeuronLink or NeuronSwitch addresses scale-up communication; EFA networking supports communication across instances. For inference, a model's weights and KV cache may similarly require multiple devices. The Trainium name does not make these serving workloads irrelevant.","zh":"对训练而言，通信是核心环节：梯度、优化器状态、激活和分片参数，需要按照并行策略在设备之间流动。NeuronLink或NeuronSwitch服务于系统内的扩展互联，EFA网络支持跨实例通信。推理时，模型权重和KV缓存也可能需要分布在多设备上，因此不能因为名字里有“Train”，就忽略其推理用途。"}],"sources":[3,4]},{"heading":{"en":"4. Neuron is part of the product","zh":"四、Neuron软件栈是产品的一部分"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"AWS Neuron connects the hardware to model code through a compiler, runtime, libraries, and profiling tools. It integrates with frameworks such as PyTorch, and the Neuron Kernel Interface provides a route for writing optimized kernels. AWS's dated release notes also document inference features such as prefix caching, disaggregated inference, and context parallelism. The exact model, chip generation, and SDK version still determine which path is supported.","zh":"AWS Neuron通过编译器、运行时、库和性能分析工具，把芯片与模型代码连接起来。它与PyTorch等框架集成，Neuron Kernel Interface（NKI）则提供编写优化kernel的途径。AWS已发布的版本公告还记录了前缀缓存、分离式推理和上下文并行等功能；具体可用路径仍取决于模型、芯片代际和SDK版本。"},{"en":"Framework compatibility is different from kernel portability. A PyTorch model may have a supported Neuron implementation while a CUDA extension, a Triton kernel targeting NVIDIA, or a particular fused attention implementation still needs replacement or adaptation. Before estimating migration effort, inspect custom operators, shapes, precision, distributed collectives, and the model's serving implementation.","zh":"框架兼容不等于底层kernel可以直接搬迁。某个PyTorch模型可能已有Neuron实现，但CUDA扩展、面向英伟达后端的Triton kernel，或某种融合注意力实现，仍可能需要替换或适配。估算迁移工作前，应检查自定义算子、张量形状、精度、分布式通信和模型服务实现。"},{"en":"A practical migration starts with one complete supported model, a pinned software environment, and a correctness baseline. Then profile the full graph and serving loop. Compiling successfully is only the first milestone; numerical quality, warm-up behavior, shape coverage, and operational stability determine whether a deployment is ready.","zh":"实际迁移可以从一个完整、已有支持的模型开始，固定软件环境并建立正确性基线，再分析整张计算图和服务循环。编译成功只是第一步，数值质量、预热行为、形状覆盖范围和运行稳定性，才决定是否适合上线。"}],"sources":[5,6,9]},{"heading":{"en":"5. Comparison with NVIDIA data-center GPUs","zh":"五、与英伟达数据中心GPU的核心差异"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"NVIDIA GPUs combine programmable parallel execution with specialized Tensor Cores; they are not merely graphics hardware repurposed without AI-specific design. Hopper and Blackwell are examples of data-center architectures used for training and inference. NVIDIA's software platform includes CUDA, cuBLAS, cuDNN, NCCL, and TensorRT-LLM, alongside integrations in open-source frameworks.","zh":"英伟达GPU把可编程并行计算与专门的Tensor Core结合起来，并不是没有AI专项设计的普通图形硬件。Hopper和Blackwell都是用于训练与推理的数据中心架构例子。其软件平台包括CUDA、cuBLAS、cuDNN、NCCL和TensorRT-LLM，也与开源框架形成广泛集成。"},{"en":"The following table compares platform characteristics. It is not a performance ranking: Inferentia2, Trainium2, Trainium3, H100, H200, B200, and B300 differ substantially, and a chip-to-chip comparison cannot be substituted for an instance-level or rack-level evaluation.","zh":"下表比较平台特征，不进行性能排名。Inferentia2、Trainium2、Trainium3与H100、H200、B200、B300之间都有明显差异；单芯片比较也不能代替实例级或机架级评测。"}],"table":{"headers":[{"en":"Dimension","zh":"维度"},{"en":"AWS Inferentia","zh":"AWS Inferentia"},{"en":"AWS Trainium","zh":"AWS Trainium"},{"en":"NVIDIA data-center GPU","zh":"英伟达数据中心GPU"}],"rows":[[{"en":"Primary positioning","zh":"主要定位"},{"en":"Inference-oriented acceleration","zh":"面向推理的专用加速"},{"en":"Large-scale training and inference","zh":"大规模训练与推理"},{"en":"Programmable accelerated computing, including AI","zh":"覆盖AI的可编程加速计算"}],[{"en":"Software stack","zh":"软件栈"},{"en":"AWS Neuron","zh":"AWS Neuron"},{"en":"AWS Neuron and NKI","zh":"AWS Neuron与NKI"},{"en":"CUDA, CUDA-X libraries, NCCL, TensorRT-LLM","zh":"CUDA、CUDA-X库、NCCL、TensorRT-LLM"}],[{"en":"Multi-device connectivity","zh":"多设备互联"},{"en":"NeuronLink on multi-chip Inf2","zh":"多芯片Inf2上的NeuronLink"},{"en":"NeuronLink / NeuronSwitch; EFA across instances","zh":"NeuronLink / NeuronSwitch；跨实例使用EFA"},{"en":"NVLink / NVSwitch where present; cluster networking","zh":"支持的系统采用NVLink / NVSwitch，并配合集群网络"}],[{"en":"Deployment access","zh":"部署方式"},{"en":"AWS services and Inf instances","zh":"AWS服务及Inf实例"},{"en":"AWS services and Trn systems","zh":"AWS服务及Trn系统"},{"en":"AWS, other clouds, and on-premises systems","zh":"AWS、其他云及本地数据中心"}],[{"en":"Existing NVIDIA kernels","zh":"已有英伟达kernel"},{"en":"Need supported equivalents or porting","zh":"需要对应支持实现或适配"},{"en":"Need supported equivalents or porting","zh":"需要对应支持实现或适配"},{"en":"Reuse within supported GPU and software versions","zh":"在兼容GPU与软件版本内复用"}],[{"en":"What to validate","zh":"评估重点"},{"en":"Serving quality, latency, throughput, and cost","zh":"推理质量、延迟、吞吐及成本"},{"en":"Time-to-quality, scaling, serving, and migration cost","zh":"达到目标质量的时间、扩展效率、推理与迁移成本"},{"en":"Workload fit, utilization, availability, and total cost","zh":"任务适配、利用率、资源可用性及总成本"}]]},"sources":[2,3,4,5,7,8]},{"heading":{"en":"6. Memory, interconnect, and precision change the answer","zh":"六、为什么不能只看峰值算力"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"A useful capacity budget includes weights, KV cache, activations, runtime buffers, and, during training, gradients and optimizer state. Summing memory across chips does not create one uniform local memory pool. Tensor or pipeline parallelism needs software partitioning, and communication can offset the benefit of additional compute.","zh":"有效的容量预算应覆盖权重、KV缓存、激活、运行时缓冲，以及训练时的梯度和优化器状态。把多颗芯片的内存相加，并不会自动得到一块统一的本地内存。张量并行或流水线并行需要软件分片，通信成本可能抵消额外算力带来的收益。"},{"en":"Prefill often exposes substantial matrix-compute work, while low-batch decode can be constrained by moving weights and cache data. Batching, attention kernels, context length, and model architecture can shift the bottleneck. For a mixture-of-experts model, routing and expert communication add another axis; a faster matrix engine alone does not establish faster end-to-end serving.","zh":"Prefill通常包含较多矩阵计算，而小批量decode可能受权重和缓存的数据搬运限制。批处理方式、注意力kernel、上下文长度和模型架构都会改变瓶颈。MoE还会增加路由与专家通信问题，因此矩阵引擎更快，并不能直接证明端到端服务更快。"},{"en":"Peak FLOPS also require matching the numerical format, dense or sparse convention, and system boundary. FP8 on one chip is not directly comparable to sparse FP4 across a rack. Low precision must pass a quality evaluation, and usable throughput should be measured under the same latency target. Vendor performance-per-dollar claims are useful leads for an experiment, not a universal result against every NVIDIA GPU.","zh":"比较峰值FLOPS时，还要统一数值格式、稠密或稀疏口径，以及统计范围。单芯片FP8不能直接对照整机架的稀疏FP4。低精度配置必须通过质量评估，可用吞吐则应在相同延迟目标下测量。厂商的性价比声明适合作为测试线索，不能当作对所有英伟达GPU都成立的结论。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"7. How I would choose for a real workload","zh":"七、真实业务如何选型"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"For a stable, supported model serving a large volume of requests on AWS, Inferentia or Trainium deserves a controlled trial. For a team already operating large AWS training jobs, Trainium is also a candidate for pretraining, fine-tuning, and subsequent serving. Where new model architectures, CUDA-heavy extensions, or cross-cloud and on-premises requirements dominate, NVIDIA's existing ecosystem may reduce integration effort. These are starting hypotheses to test, not guarantees.","zh":"对于AWS上长期运行、请求量大且已有软件支持的模型，可以把Inferentia或Trainium纳入对照试验。已经在AWS运营大规模训练的团队，也可评估Trainium用于预训练、微调及后续推理。如果业务经常试验新架构、深度依赖CUDA扩展，或必须跨云与本地部署，英伟达现有生态可能降低集成工作量。这些是待验证的选型假设，并非性能保证。"},{"en":"For inference, fix the checkpoint, quality threshold, prompt and output distributions, concurrency, and latency objective. Measure time to first token, inter-token latency, tail latency, successful requests, throughput, and full service cost. For training, compare time and cost to reach the same validation quality, including checkpointing, restart behavior, and scaling efficiency. A faster training step is not enough if more steps are needed to converge.","zh":"推理评测应固定检查点、质量门槛、输入输出长度分布、并发和延迟目标，记录首token延迟、token间延迟、尾延迟、成功请求数、吞吐及完整服务成本。训练则比较达到同一验证质量所需的时间和成本，并计入检查点、故障恢复和扩展效率。若收敛需要更多步，单步更快也不足以说明整体更好。"},{"en":"Finally, include engineering time: porting kernels, maintaining a second backend, operating compilation caches, debugging failures, and securing capacity. A simple break-even estimate divides one-time migration cost by measured monthly savings, provided the comparison holds quality and service levels constant. The right platform is the one that delivers the required result sustainably, with a software and operational burden the team can support.","zh":"最后应计入工程时间：kernel迁移、第二套后端维护、编译缓存管理、故障排查和容量获取。一个简单的回本估算是，用一次性迁移成本除以实测月度节省，前提是质量和服务水平保持一致。合适的平台，应能持续交付所需结果，同时让团队承担得起相应的软件与运维成本。"}]}],"sources":[{"title":"AWS — Inferentia2 architecture and capabilities","date":"2023-06-13","url":"https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/aws-inferentia2-builds-on-aws-inferentia1-by-delivering-4x-higher-throughput-and-10x-lower-latency/"},{"title":"AWS
